text: Training Levels:For students having mastered about 4500 words. Teaching Objectives:After they conclude one academic year's study and acquire the required credit points, they are supposed to have a vocabulary of 8000 words or so and vocabulary、discourse、rhetoric of the advanced phase. Training Hours:One academic year contains two terms, the first term will last for 20 weeks. and the second term will last for 20 weeks, 40 weeks in total. There are 12-18 teaching hours per week, altogether 480-720 teaching
